Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of ABBV.
We delivered record revenue of $2.9 billion this quarter, representing 6% year-over-year growth.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 6% to 25% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2021.
We generated $4.1 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 98 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. Operating income reached $11.2 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
